definitions.title: Work Done by a Variable Force
definitions.statement: The work done by a continuous variable force F(x) directed along the x-axis in moving an object from x = a to x = b is the definite integral of F(x).
conditions: F(x) is continuous along displacement path
definitions.explanation: Extends elementary physics formula Work = Force * Distance to continuously varying forces.
definitions.keyTakeaway: Work equals the area under the force-displacement curve.

definitions.title: Hooke's Law for Spring Work
definitions.latex: F(x) = k x \implies W = \int_a^b k x \, dx = \frac{1}{2} k (b^2 - a^2)
definitions.statement: The restoring force of an elastic spring is directly proportional to its displacement x from natural equilibrium. The work required to stretch a spring from x = a to x = b is (1/2)k(b^2 - a^2).
definitions.explanation: k is the spring constant measured in N/m or lb/ft.
definitions.keyTakeaway: Spring potential energy increases quadratically with displacement.
